raise_justifications.desktop/macos/Desktop/Sources/AppState/A: Two independent silent-mic fixes meet in this file: the microphone authorization gate at the capture choke point with the honest permission alert (a notDetermined/revoked TCC entry otherwise arms a zero-sample stream and the watchdog loops a misleading hardware alert every ~90s), and silentMicHealedDeviceID plus the SilentMicRoutePolicy call at the rebuild site (the healed input route must survive a CoreAudio rebuild or the rebuild re-resolves the system default back onto the silent device).
